episodes.title: The National Anthem
episodes.summary: Prime Minister Michael Callow faces a huge and shocking dilemma when Princess Susannah, a much-loved member of the Royal Family, is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Fifteen Million Merits
episodes.summary: In the near future, everyone is confined to a life of strange physical drudgery. The only way to escape is to enter the 'Hot Shot' talent show and pray you can impress the judges.

episodes.title: The Entire History of You
episodes.summary: A jealous husband, Liam Foxwell, suspects that his wife was involved with another man. Thanks to an implant that lets anyone play memories back as long and as often as they want, he sets out to confirm his suspicions.

episodes.title: Be Right Back
episodes.summary: When a man named Ash dies, his girlfriend Martha is grief-stricken... until a friend directs her to a service that can create an AI programmed with Ash's online personality. Eventually the software offers Martha a new improvement: a physical body for it to occupy.

episodes.title: White Bear
episodes.summary: A woman, Victoria, wakes up with amnesia and a fellow survivor tells her that nine-tenths of the world's population have been turned into photo-taking zombies by a mysterious TV signal. To get to safety, they have to evade the sadistic hunters and destroy the White Bear transmitter. However, Victoria soon realizes that something far more sinister is going on.

episodes.title: The Waldo Moment
episodes.summary: An animated blue bear, Waldo, proves surprisingly successful as a third-party candidate. But Jamie Salter, the voice of Waldo, begins to have second thoughts when he learns what the governments of the world intend to use Waldo for.

episodes.title: Nosedive
episodes.summary: A woman desperate to boost her social media score hits the jackpot when she's invited to a swanky wedding. But the trip doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Playtest
episodes.summary: An American traveler short on cash signs up to test a revolutionary new gaming system, only to discover the thrills are a little too real.

episodes.title: Shut Up and Dance
episodes.summary: After a virus infects his laptop, a teen faces a daunting choice: carry out orders delivered by text message, or risk having intimate secrets exposed.

episodes.title: San Junipero
episodes.summary: In a seaside town in 1987, a shy young woman and an outgoing party girl strike up a powerful bond that seems to defy the laws of space and time.

episodes.title: Men Against Fire
episodes.summary: After his first battle with an elusive enemy, a soldier begins experiencing unfamiliar sensations and strange technical glitches.

episodes.title: Hated in the Nation
episodes.summary: The death of a journalist at the center of a social media firestorm leads a veteran detective and her tech-savvy apprentice to a chilling discovery.

episodes.title: USS Callister
episodes.summary: Capt. Robert Daly presides over his crew with wisdom and courage. But a new recruit will soon discover nothing on this spaceship is what it seems.

episodes.title: Arkangel
episodes.summary: Worried about her daughter's safety, single mom Marie signs up for a cutting-edge device that monitors the girl's whereabouts -- and much more.

episodes.title: Crocodile
episodes.summary: Architect Mia scrambles to keep a dark secret under wraps, while insurance investigator Shazia harvests people's memories of a nearby accident scene.

episodes.title: Hang the DJ
episodes.summary: Paired up by a dating program that puts an expiration date on all relationships, Frank and Amy soon begin to question the system's logic.

episodes.title: Metalhead
episodes.summary: At an abandoned warehouse, scavengers searching for supplies encounter a ruthless foe and flee for their lives through a bleak wasteland.

episodes.title: Black Museum
episodes.summary: On a dusty stretch of highway, a traveler stumbles across a museum that boasts rare criminal artifacts -- and a disturbing main attraction.

episodes.title: Striking Vipers
episodes.summary: When old college friends Danny and Karl reconnect in a VR version of their favorite video game, the late-night sessions yield an unexpected discovery.

episodes.title: Smithereens
episodes.summary: A London rideshare driver ignites an international crisis when he kidnaps a worker from a social media company.

episodes.title: Rachel, Jack and Ashley, Too
episodes.summary: A lonely teen becomes obsessed with a robot doll based on her pop star idol, Ashley O -- just as the real Ashley's life begins to unravel.

episodes.title: Joan Is Awful
episodes.summary: An average woman is stunned to discover a global streaming platform has launched a prestige TV drama adaptation of her life — in which she is portrayed by Hollywood A-lister Salma Hayek.

episodes.title: Loch Henry
episodes.summary: A young couple travel to a sleepy Scottish town to start work on a genteel nature documentary – but find themselves drawn to a juicy local story involving shocking events of the past.

episodes.title: Beyond the Sea
episodes.summary: In an alternative 1969, two men on a perilous high-tech mission wrestle with the consequences of an unimaginable tragedy.

episodes.title: Mazey Day
episodes.summary: A troubled starlet is dogged by invasive paparazzi while dealing with the consequences of a hit-and-run incident.

episodes.title: Demon 79
episodes.summary: Northern England, 1979. A meek sales assistant is told she must commit terrible acts to prevent disaster.

episodes.title: Common People
episodes.summary: When a medical emergency leaves schoolteacher Amanda fighting for her life, her desperate husband Mike signs her up for Rivermind, a high-tech system that will keep her alive.

episodes.title: Bête Noire
episodes.summary: Confectionary whizz kid Maria is unnerved when her former schoolmate Verity joins the company she works at — because there's something altogether odd about Verity, something only Maria seems to notice…

episodes.title: Hotel Reverie
episodes.summary: A high-tech, unusually immersive remake of a vintage British film sends Hollywood A-list star Brandy Friday into another dimension, where she must stick to the script if she ever wants to make it home.

episodes.title: Plaything
episodes.summary: In a near-future London, an eccentric murder suspect is linked to an unusual video game from the 1990s — a game populated by cute, evolving artificial lifeforms.

episodes.title: Eulogy
episodes.summary: An isolated man is introduced to a groundbreaking system that allows its users to literally step inside old photographs — stirring powerful emotions in the process.

episodes.title: USS Callister: Into Infinity
episodes.summary: Robert Daly is dead, but now the crew of the USS Callister – led by Captain Nanette Cole – are stranded in an infinite virtual universe, fighting for survival against 30 million players.
